shared_change_policy: This file is a proposal only. The track does not modify the shared grammar, producer registry, state contract, runtime or frontier.

common_internal_serializer.admission_rule: The internal artifact must recompute terminal/hit/F/G from canonical target integers. Only a final F/G successor projected into PersistentSelectorStateV1 may be offered to the common queue gate.

target_shapes.mark_behavior: Consume the inherited ROOT_SOL receipt only to reconstruct a terminal certificate for the same root; emit no persistent mark.
target_shapes.t2_request: Reuse T2v1_A_H4 or T2v1_A_C8 to validate the source-specific internal atomic payload before terminalization.
target_shapes.t3_request: No T3 extension if the input mark is ROOT_SOL and the output is terminal.

target_shapes.owner_precedence_request: After terminal-first, select the first independently matching active Type-I specialization. A conditional new atomic-F owner must be below existing geometry-specific specializations and above no-match rejection.
